text:
indie game delevopment is officially dead

some guy with a Chinese GitHub profile gave GPT-6 Astra one shot

it shipped a playable browser game with:
→ soft-body fruit physics
→ collisions and chain merges
→ score tracking
→ a complete standalone HTML build

then he dropped the original prompt and the game on GitHub

we used to call this a small game studio
